messages:
alex: Heads up — pushing forward with a co-marketing/demo webinar + linked blog with PartnerACME. Goal: 300 registrants, 30% MQL conversion, and marketplace listing link + benchmark snippet.

maria: +1. Proposed date: Wed May 8 11am PT. Is that still ok for PartnerACME?

partner_acme: yep wed 5/8 works. prefer 11a PT. we'll have our product lead (Dana) and a solutions engineer.

sam: I can own the Redwood demo portion and short benchmark slide (latency/cost) — need final model/instance numbers by Friday.

alex: perfect. jamal can you draft the landing page copy + UTMs? we need: utm_source=partner_acme, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=acme-integration-2026

jamal: working on copy. quick Q: are we routing marketplace-origin leads differently? partner wants co-ownership of inbound.

katie: routing plan: marketplace leads -> SFDC lead record with fields: LeadSource=Marketplace_PartnerACME, Partner_Touch=Yes, AssignTo=marketplace_queue. Partner-owned leads tagged PartnerACME_Lead=true.

alex: can you paste the exact field names we should map? Ops needs it for the integration.

katie: sure — use these exact keys for the webhook: product_source=marketplace, campaign=acme_integration_2026, partner_name=PartnerACME, partner_owner_email=partner@acme.com

sam: also add 'demo_env=acme-light' so we can auto-provision.

partner_acme: for the blog co-auth, we prefer a 800–1000 word post. we'll draft opening section. Redwood to provide benchmark chart + quote.

maria: timeline: draft landing + form -> Wed Apr 24, sponsor deck + slides -> Mon Apr 29, blog draft by Fri May 3, final rehearsal Tue May 7.

alex: registrant promo plan: Redwood email to existing marketplace users (50k), partner email to their list (30k), paid ads (optional). target 300 regs.

jamal: included a quick submit form snippet for ops:

```
POST /webhooks/marketplace
Content-Type: application/json
{
 "email": "...",
 "utm_source": "partner_acme",
 "campaign": "acme_integration_2026",
 "product_source": "marketplace"
}
```

katie: Ops notes: make sure webhook includes `partner_owner_email` and `partner_owner_type=partner` so we can auto-assign. Also include `lead_tier` (hot/warm) based on answers.

alex: who's handling the webinar platform? Zoom or Hopin?

maria: Zoom webinar. zoom-bot will create link after we add registrants list.

zoom-bot: created webinar id 987654321 — registrants form: https://zoom.us/webinar/register/987654321

sam: I'll set the demo to 10 minutes, then 20-minute Q&A. Need 5 min handoff script.

partner_acme: Dana will do integration overview (8-10 min), SE will cover install & marketplace listing (5 min).

alex: action items:
 - jamal: landing copy + UTMs (due Apr 24)
 - katie: SFDC field mapping + webhook spec (due Apr 23)
 - sam: benchmark numbers + slides (due Apr 29)
 - partner_acme: blog intro + speaker bios (due Apr 30)
 - maria: schedule rehearsals + Zoom setup (in flight)

jamal: noted. adding draft to /drive/marketing/partners/acme/webinar/ — ping when ready.

katie: FYI: for lead routing QA, ops will run a test payload on Apr 26.

alex: perfect. one more ask — marketing needs a short benchmark blurb (1–2 sentences) we can put on the landing. Sam, can you draft two variants (one tech, one customer-facing)?

sam: sending both by Thu.

partner_acme: we'll share partner banner assets and marketplace icon by Apr 22.

maria: great. i'll create the calendar invites after we have speaker confirmations.

alex: thanks everyone. i'll follow up with a 1-pager + tracking doc after this thread.

ops-bot: scheduled lead routing QA on 2026-04-26T13:00:00Z

maria: bumping this — any blockers? :eyes: 

jamal: none from copy side. working on UTM variants for A/B subject lines.

katie: no blockers. ops ready for webhook test.

alex: closing loop — will post final checklist Monday.
